criteria.NOT_WAIVABLE: Functional feedback or mixed functional/observer block; zero found in the 776 candidates.
criteria.UNPROVEN: Unclosed source identity, block mapping or fanout; zero in the source candidates. Native application is a separate unproven axis for all 776.
criteria.native_application: No DVE mapping/load/save validation; XML linebb checksums are NOT saved native DVE pointchecksums. No exclusion directives generated.
